subject: Spring Into FREE Climbing ☀️
body_text:
https://centralrockgym.com/fenway/day-pass-membership-deal/

This week, we're saying goodbye to winter and hellooo to spring.

We love a good season change, especially when it means more and more sunshine to fuel a new hobby that builds strength, confidence, and community. Right now, you can climb FREE for the rest of March for the price of a day pass when you commit to a month of membership in April!

Offer Ends March 20th!
JOIN NOW (https://centralrockgym.com/fenway/day-pass-membership-deal/)
https://centralrockgym.com/fenway/day-pass-membership-deal/

Climb Higher

Our FREE classes are led by instructors who will help you build skills and community in a no pressure, all fun environment.

More Than A Wall

We're more than just a climbing gym! We also offer a fitness area where you can build conditioning and strength between sessions.
https://centralrockgym.com/fenway/day-pass-membership-deal/

Other Perks

Access to all CRG locations | Free rental gear | One guest pass per month | Free events | Refer a Friend program | Access to Truemed to pay using HSA/FSA

HELLOOO SPRING. HELLOOO FREE CLIMBING.
JOIN NOW (https://centralrockgym.com/fenway/day-pass-membership-deal/)

Offer ends March 20, 2026. Offer available to anyone who has not been a member in the past 3 months. Must commit to at least one full month of membership dues in April.
